summary: COSCIENS Biopharma furnished a Form 6-K referencing its going-private transaction via a Share Capital Amendment and SEC Reporting Suspension, building on a Schedule 13E-3 filed April 4, 2026. The company seeks to reduce shareholder count below 300 to deregister with the SEC and suspend U.S. reporting, aiming to cut costs. The transaction is subject to TSX approval and involves a reverse stock split or consolidation to squeeze out minority holders. There is no stated price per share or premium; the plan relies on corporate mechanics rather than a buyout. What to watch: regulatory approvals and any dissenter appraisal rights.
